Founder Lunch & Learn: Identify What Matters

Tsai CITY Calendar
Tsai Center for Innovative Thinking at Yale
New Haven, CT
Registration
Welcome! To join the event, please register below.
About Event

​In this lunch-and-learn panel, three advanced student founders will share how they approach the practice of identification in innovation, from defining purpose and intended impact to identifying initial users, audiences, customers, and partners.

​The conversation will offer a practical look at how student founders are working through these foundational questions as their ventures develop. Attendees will also have the opportunity to ask questions, hear directly from peers navigating the founder journey, and learn from the decisions shaping their work.

​All Tsai CITY Venture Development Program participants and others interested in student founders' work are welcome.
